equipment.name: Anvil sigil
equipment.desc: The model and its attached unit gain +1 Attack until the end of the current Battle round, if it successfully recited a prayer.

equipment.name: Drake-scale cloak
equipment.desc: All to wound rolls against the model suffer a -1 penalty. Unique.

equipment.name: Drake-smiter
equipment.desc: If the model is equipped with a Thunder hammer, it may choose to make some or all melee attacks at Initiative 1, but gains Strength: D for these attacks. Unique.

equipment.name: Promethean masterwork
equipment.desc: A "Bolt" weapon of the model gains +1 Strength and the "Rending(5+)" ability.

equipment.name: Tome of Vel'cona
equipment.desc: The model gains a +1 bonus to manifest powers from the Pyromancy discipline.

equipment.name: Flameforged hull
equipment.desc: Enemy attacks receive a -1 AT penalty (to a minimum of 0).
